content: 1. Dronabinol and Cefotetan: Cefotetan increases the toxicity of dronabinol by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. This combination is contraindicated. Cefotetan should be discontinued at least 14 days before starting dronabinol, and it should not be administered within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 2. Dronabinol and Disulfiram: Disulfiram increases dronabinol toxicity through aldehyde dehydrogenase inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. Disulfiram should be stopped at least 14 days before starting dronabinol, and it should not be used within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 3. Dronabinol and Metronidazole: Metronidazole increases dronabinol toxicity via aldehyde dehydrogenase inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. Metronidazole should be discontinued at least 14 days before starting dronabinol, and it should not be used within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 4. Dronabinol and Tinidazole: Tinidazole increases dronabinol toxicity through aldehyde dehydrogenase inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. Tinidazole should be stopped at least 14 days before starting dronabinol, and it should not be used within 7 days of completing dronabinol treatment. 5. Dronabinol and Apalutamide: Apalutamide decreases the levels or effects of dronabinol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, monitor for reduced therapeutic effects and adjust the dose as needed. 6. Dronabinol and Danazol: Danazol increases the levels or effects of dronabinol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 7. Dronabinol and Fexinidazole: Fexinidazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Monitor for adverse effects if coadministration is necessary. 8. Dronabinol and Ivosidenib: Ivosidenib decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, monitor for reduced therapeutic effects. 9. Dronabinol and Metoclopramide (Intranasal): This combination increases the effects of both drugs. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug, depending on the importance of each medication to the patient. 10. Dronabinol and Nelfinavir: Nelfinavir increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. 11. Dronabinol and Olopatadine (Intranasal): Both drugs increase sedation. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. Coadministration increases the risk of central nervous system (CNS) depression, leading to impaired psychomotor performance and daytime drowsiness. 12. Dronabinol and Ropeginterferon Alfa-2b: This combination increases the risk of neuropsychiatric side effects. Avoid this combination or monitor patients closely for excessive CNS toxicity. 13. Dronabinol and Tucatinib: Tucatinib increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the dose of CYP3A4 substrates according to product labeling. 14. Dronabinol and Zuranolone: This combination increases CNS depressant effects. Avoid this combination or consider dose reduction if coadministration is unavoidable. 15. Dronabinol and Alpelisib: Alpelisib decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. 16. Dronabinol and Amiodarone: Amiodarone increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 17.
